title: 2023上海马拉松安全圆满完赛 赛会纪录大幅提升（上海市体育局）
publisher: 上海市体育局（上海体育）
claims: The 2023 Shanghai Marathon was the 28th edition; 20,000 full-marathon runners and 18,000 fitness-run runners started from the Bund Bull Square on 26 November 2023.

Men's winner Philemon Kiptoo Kipchumba (Kenya) ran 2:05:35, breaking an eight-year-old course record and setting the fastest marathon ever run in mainland China at the time; Alphonce Felix Simbu (Tanzania) was second and Solomon Kirwa Yego (Kenya) third.
Women's winner Siranesh Yirga Dagne (Ethiopia) ran 2:21:28; Sally Chepyego Kaptich (Kenya) was second and Eunice Chebichii Chumba (Bahrain) third.
The race closed after 6 hours 15 minutes, with the finish cut-off at 13:15.

Medical provision: 49 medical stations at start, finish and along the course, 36监护 ambulances, 80 cycling first-aid team members, 21 patrol posts, 230 first-aid runners, nine designated hospitals with dedicated clinics, and 15 sweep buses.
About 4,600 volunteers from ten universities and the organising group served the race; the course had 12 music stations.
Sub-3:00 finishers received an extra sub-three windbreaker; finishers within the cut-off received a finisher T-shirt and finish bag.
